s00343.summary: Corinne and Artie walk the dim mirror maze; she questions him about a figure in the mirror.
Her reflection moves on its own, and she demands a way out.
Artie admits he is trapped and that she, like him, stayed too long.

s00548.summary: Bhaskar, silent, finally demands an apology from Willoughby for the dishonest run-out.
Florence arrives, calls the match, and backs Bhaskar's accusation against Willoughby.
Willoughby concedes and apologizes grudgingly to Bhaskar, Florence and the game.
Florence pours tea and the three old foes sit listening to the rain.

s01999.summary: Miriam sets up in the abandoned booth and starts recording on a cassette.
Miriam replies to her younger recorded voice, remembering listeners long gone.
Miriam announces the station closing and records a goodbye to her listeners.

s00579.summary: Jules crosses the beam to flirt with seamstress Odette, who fits him a harness.
Inspector Bouchard climbs up and questions Jules about where he was Tuesday night.
Odette lies that Jules was with her, and Bouchard reluctantly leaves.
Relieved, Jules acknowledges her cover and Odette quietly resumes sewing.

s01698.summary: A traveler asks to cross; the troll demands a true story as toll.
Maelis admits she was a queen who killed her brother for the crown.
Maelis carefully crosses the swaying bridge, skipping the third plank.
Orval helps her up and questions her name before she walks into the mist.

s01017.summary: Ingrid and Baptiste tend the dogs as Race Control orders a rushed departure.
Baptiste shows Ash is dehydrated and must be pulled; Ingrid refuses.
Ingrid scratches from the race to stay with Ash while Baptiste brings water.

s00099.summary: Clemence presses Suleiman to explain why he boarded her night train.
Suleiman turns; they admit counting the years and what might have been.
A lurch throws her into his arms; she slaps him, then weeps against him.

s00869.summary: Alaric draws water from the enchanted well and drinks at dawn.
Percival emerges from the trees, startling Alaric, and soothes him with wry peace.
Percival explains the well shows what you have lost and urges Alaric to look.
Alaric sees something pale in the water and is visibly shattered.
Alaric asks about the village, refuses company, and walks off with Percival trailing.

s01016.summary: Four lost friends reach a fork in the corn maze and argue directions.
Stalks snap nearby and a feed-sack-headed figure rises from the left path.
They scream and sprint through the corn, pursued, into a clearing with a scarecrow.
The scarecrow turns its head toward them and they scatter.

s00318.summary: Adults in tiny chairs play tea party with four-year-old Zuri.
Zuri claims a spill and everyone blames somebody else.
Zuri calls nap time; the adults lower their heads and she peeks, smiling.

s00999.summary: Surgeon Iyer readies instruments and counts Ludmilla down despite his shaking hands.
Iyer begins operating on the rattling train while Ludmilla grips the table.
Ludmilla confesses she is a partisan courier and whispers a name hidden in her coat.
Lightning flashes as they count down and she loses consciousness; Iyer finishes the sutures.
Iyer checks her coat lining and she reveals she was awake, testing him.

s00543.summary: Francine wrestles a stuck lug nut and refuses Lenny's help as tension builds.
Lenny says their mother called; the siblings spar over who left.
Lenny admits he should have called or come, and frees the nut.
They change the tire together and recall their father and how Lenny protected her.
Lenny reveals their mother is sick; Francine agrees to come Sunday.

s01379.summary: At a tied championship ninth frame, the team watches Ruby step up to spare.
Ruby's ball leaves one pin wobbling, and it stands.
Ruby folds her towel in defeat; Devon hands back her ball and takes the approach.

s01985.summary: Wet Arslan arrives and trades barbed banter with curator Izabela.
She pours him chicory; they recall the blowtorch coffee and the smoke alarm.
They discuss the orchid that bloomed after eleven years and admire it.
She laughs and joins him; Arslan says he can wait for the second bloom.

s00161.summary: The crew races through the freezing seed vault to retrieve the wheat before scrubbers fail.
The ship shudders, a klaxon sounds, and cooling is lost on Deck Nine.
Commander Larkspur enters armed and forbids anyone to touch the seed.
Ifeoma appeals to their shared oath and asks him to open the lock.
Larkspur lowers his gun and opens the lock; the crew flees with the seed.

s02293.summary: A clown named Gus insists he is hired entertainment in the dentist's waiting room.
Milo shrieks and the adults collide at the lollipop bowl in slapstick chaos.
Milo stops crying and asks Gus to do the dog again; Gus honks.

s00569.summary: Nervous newcomer Hugo twitches backstage as veterans tease him about his personality-less lamb.
The PA calls contestants; the dummy falls and all three collide in a heap.
They patch the dummy's jaw and lamb's ear with duct tape, encouraging Hugo.
Hugo finds his lamb's voice and marches to the stage with the others.

s00129.summary: In the empty converted church, rival bowlers wait for the season's last frame.
Nadine says twelve years of silence is too long; Deacon asks his mother what he doesn't know.
Gus reveals Deacon's father had two families; Nadine confirms she is his half-sister.
Deacon bowls a strike, then offers Nadine the ball and asks her to roll.

s02435.summary: At supper in a remote way station, a late coach and rumors of someone outside unsettle the group.
Abigail asks why the marshal is at the station; Magdalena says he is waiting on someone.
Abigail and Reuben both name her as Harlan Boyce's killer; she calmly explains eleven years of waiting.

s01922.summary: Teo threads film while Lula hangs out in the booth he claims is private.
Uninvited Hamid exposes Lula's remark and goads Teo, who nearly lunges.
Mrs. Vanterpool appears, asks about the blank screen, and Teo takes the blame.
She hands back the reel, telling Teo to fix it and the others to buy popcorn.

s00028.summary: Roman arrives three years late and explains why he left, asking only to stand there.
Eloise turns and softens on hearing his mother died, joking about his scarf.
Coworkers crowd in; Dr. Penhallow outs Eloise's years of talking about Roman.
Posing for a photo, they whisper dinner plans and slip out the back together.

s00807.summary: Andrej crawls through a duct and rehearses his vault heist plan with a recorder.
He catches a mistake in the safe combination and corrects it with a nervous joke.
A red light sweeps across the vent; he freezes, then slides the first bolt loose.

s00030.summary: Maren accuses her father Florian of selling their late mother's hives without asking.
Florian explains he can no longer lift the supers and had to sell.
Florian gives Maren a taste of the last honey from the north hives, her mother's.

s01357.summary: Kitchen staff share a bottle and guess who the silent stranger in gray is.
The stranger gives his name, Leopold, and says he used to cook there; Imani salts the soup.

s01406.summary: Bernadette stands at the sink letting water run as the wall phone rings unanswered.
Bernadette answers and hears from the hospice nurse that her husband has died.
She hangs up, pours tea for the empty chair, and holds her own mug close.
